dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Cadastral maps showing property lines, line dimensions, and lot numbers for 1 or 2 squares. Some sheets do not show lots.

Cadastral maps showing property lines, line dimensions, and lot numbers for 1 or 2 squares. Some sheets do not show lots. Title varies: Plan of squares nos. ... Washington D.C. Squares individually numbered in the title. Pen-and-ink and pencil. Lot areas on some maps lightly tinted. Some sheets watermarked: J Whatman 1872. In pencil on verso of some sheets: Maps of Washington property. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Some LC sheets stained, taped, or have fold lines. Vault DCP
